what: The last build papers, 24 Oct 2026 (Andrew: 'I have more dockets this will be the last for the build yah'; then 'So we need fencing to be 100% now and we work off number we have for completion of build'): hire agreements 36757 (21 Oct) and 36765-36768 (23 Oct), service note 24492 (22 Oct), signed Advanced Temporary Fencing papers photographed by Andrew.

ops.note: Mesh fence 70 m (28 panels), 22 bases, 34 clamps, 9 wheels, installed 21 Oct 2026 at The Spit - Transporter Compound (the paper missing from the 36751-36764 batch). Programme EVENT WEEK row 17 (19 Oct): Perimeter Fence - Supercars Transporter Compound, The Spit; an earlier paper carried 492.5 m at the Seaway carpark, The Spit, on 19 Oct. The 9 wheels are vehicle gates, recorded as components (gates are inside the card's metre). No bracing metres or scrim written, so clean is recorded - Advanced's sheet decides. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper. Both signatures dated 21/10/26.

Labour '15 mins x 2 men', quantity 1/2 HR; notes 'Relocated 30 m.' at the Transporter Compound (The Spit) on 22 Oct 2026, the day after hire agreement 36757 there. Company Coates V8s, contact Brendan. Owner/site supervisor and installer signatures dated 22/10/26. Prices blank.

Mesh fence 5 m (2 panels), 4 clamps, 2 wheels, installed 23 Oct 2026 at Gate 5 - Ocean Ave; the Base box holds a dash (no bases). The 2 wheels on 2 panels read as a wheeled gate, recorded as components (gates are inside the card's metre). Clean recorded - no bracing or scrim written. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices blank. Both signatures dated 23/10/26.

CC barrier 10 m (4 barriers), installed 23 Oct 2026 at the Smoking Zone - Breaker St. The printed number reads like 36765 at phone size; at full size the last figure is a 6 (36765 is the Gate 5 paper). Event: the paper does not say; smoking zones have been Event since Andrew accepted it on 2 Oct (programme CON WK3 smoking rows and EVENT WEEK row 11 are Event), and Andrew was told Event would be recorded unless he said otherwise. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices blank. Both signatures dated 23/10/26.
